ONE accurate South Korean Taegeukgi, a complete flat white rectangular flag, seen FRONT-ON without folds, on a simple short pole. White cloth rendered with brush texture only at its edges, true RED upper lobe and true BLUE lower lobe in the central taegeuk. Four exact BLACK trigrams: upper left GEON has three UNBROKEN parallel bars (111); upper right GAM has BROKEN outer bars and an UNBROKEN middle bar (010); lower left RI has UNBROKEN outer bars and a BROKEN middle bar (101); lower right GON has THREE BROKEN bars (000). Trigrams sit diagonally around the center as on the real Korean national flag; clean gaps and no extra bars. Do NOT interchange upper right and lower left, do not make all trigrams the same. No perspective distortion or decorative changes to the emblem. Warm-white brush cloth, pure black surrounding background. No lettering or other symbols. This is the only allowed blue/red color exception.
